Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: landscape 16:9 game BACKGROUND, high detail, no people.
Input image: STYLE reference only. Make a NEW map in the same delightful hand-drawn chibi game illustration style with fine warm brown outlines and pastel cel shading.
Theme: a botanical garden festival, greenhouse pavilions, flower carts, fountains, rose arches and cute gazebos.
Composition: high overhead oblique view, no sky and no horizon. Fully illustrated edge-to-edge. Main playable walking network MUST be clear empty pale paving: broad horizontal promenade across full width at 35% image height; second broad horizontal promenade at 68% height; vertical walkways at 18%, 50% and 82% image width connect the two and extend toward top and bottom. Keep these specified walkway centerlines completely clear and wide (about 8% image height). Corners and spaces BETWEEN the routes contain tightly packed cute shops and tiny props. A few low stalls on plaza edges. No tall object across the walkway centers. Subtle paving variations and tiny flowers add detail without blocking paths.
This map must support 500 independently overlaid moving sprite characters, so visual complexity comes from architecture around generous walkable spaces.
Constraints: ZERO humans, no human riders or shopkeepers, no humanoid statues or dolls. No interface, no typography, no text, no logo, no watermark. No baked-in living characters. Do not make collage or multiple panels.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: actual walking animation sprite atlas for a 2D cute crowd search game.
Input: visual style reference only.
Create EXACTLY 75 separated complete-body sprite frames arranged in a STRICT 15-column by 5-row uniform rectangular grid. Desired image dimensions 3840 x 1280 pixels (3:1). Each row is ONE same consistent character in a 15-frame COMPLETE seamless walking cycle; exactly 15 frames across, foot position changing smoothly from contact through passing and opposite contact back to contact, slight arms swing. ALL face right, slight overhead three-quarter camera. Each character stays centered in equal cell, same scale, same common foot baseline; hats and feet never cross cell boundaries. Full body. 15 different walking phases, not 15 different outfits.
Row 1 character: leaf-topped yellow beret, brown short hair, cream shirt, teal overalls, coral backpack.
Row 2 character: dark bob hair, cream sunhat, coral summer dress, tote bag.
Row 3 character: older gray-haired man, round spectacles, blue shirt, navy trousers.
Row 4 character: dark curly-haired child, lavender hoodie, ochre shorts.
Row 5 character: young person with dark skin, mint cap, striped sailor shirt, navy shorts.
Style: match reference adorable 2.5-head chibi humans, warm cocoa outlines, clean pastel colors, light cel shading, expressive faces. Preserve exact outfit, face, accessories and proportions across each entire row.
TRUE transparent alpha background everywhere outside characters. No background painting, no gradients, no ground shadows, no captions, no frame numbers, no grid lines, no props outside character. Maintain generous clear transparent gutters around every sprite. Production sprite sheet, not a scene.
